title: Impact Of Bhakti Movement
definition: A socio-religious reform movement spanning the 7th to 17th centuries that emphasized personal devotion (Bhakti) to a deity, challenging the rigid caste hierarchy and ritualistic dominance of the Brahmanical orthodoxy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims (Art & Culture/History) and Mains (GS-I: Indian Culture/Society) for its role in shaping regional identities, vernacular literature, and social egalitarianism.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Impact Of Bhakti Movement.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Medieval Indian History
Understanding of Vedic vs. Puranic Hinduism
